name.zh: 大教授开始删除史黛菈人格
name.en: The Grand Professor Begins Erasing Stella's Personality

periods.type: abduction / mind-control operation / villain plan reveal
periods.location: Karl Eilands' secret laboratory beneath an abandoned mine in Nikko, Tochigi
periods.summary: Karl Eilands imprisons Stella in a medical tank and begins a procedure to erase the Crimson Princess identity so her body can serve as the mother-body for his perfect-human project.
periods.cause: Eilands wants to combine the Tyrant's soul-information from Blutsauger with an exceptional Desperado mother-body; Stella's body meets his desired physical and magical standards, but her will would reject the plan.
periods.process: Researchers measure Stella's body and confirm her suitability. Eilands explains the failure of the Abraham Project and his plan to use the Tyrant's Device as soul/genetic material. Stella is drugged, oxygen-restricted, connected to brain-reading equipment, and Abraham Carter uses Gospel and Mind Control to alter her memories and destroy the experiences that formed her identity.
periods.outcome: The operation is projected to finish in about five hours, and Eilands believes Stella's remaining self will collapse once her past is rewritten. The rescue team later races against this countdown.
casualties: Stella is unconscious, drugged and psychologically attacked
periods.significance: Defines Eilands' endgame, explains the Abraham Project's flaw, and establishes the urgent time limit for Stella's rescue.
